base.query: Which earlier scene shows whom my chosen ferryman carried across?

pool.body: Tally marks covered a wooden post near a jetty.
Lanterns burned under a violet sky in a town of mirrors.
Dust settled over a map with torn edges.
Wind tugged at a shutter on an empty inn.
Mott counted coins alone in a locked booth.
A ferry post held a copied line: Which earlier scene shows whom my chosen ferryman carried across? No one answered it.

Market bells rang late because of rain. Lio counted coins for lamp oil beside a stall of onions. At dusk Bren set her down on the far stones and pushed off again into the mist. A baker swept flour from his step.
Lio weighed lamp oil into small jars for a line of buyers.
